T: Who you gonna call. The diner.
D: A single mum and her kids move into her late father's Oklahoma farmhouse and find what he left behind.
P: Serve the snacks when the tiny marshmallow men get loose in the supermarket.
S: Marshmallows on skewers with chocolate faces, toasted if you like
Big marshmallows stacked in twos on skewers, eyes and smile piped in melted dark chocolate, half of them toasted with a blowtorch.
Cornmeal crusted fried okra rounds with hot sauce
Okra cut into rounds, tossed in cornmeal and fried crisp, with hot sauce. Slice 500g okra into 1cm rounds, toss in 150ml buttermilk, then in 150g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, salt and pepper.
the dusty old farmhouse full of secrets

Golden cornbread baked in a hot cast iron pan with corn kernels and jalapeño, served warm in wedges with whipped honey butter and flaky salt. Heat the oven to 210C with a 25cm cast iron pan inside. Mix 200g fine polenta, 150g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Whisk 300ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 80g melted butter, stir into the dry mix with 150g corn kernels and 1 chopped jalapeño. Add 20g butter to the hot pan, pour in the batter and bake 20 to 25 minutes. Beat 100g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and serve with the warm wedges.
M: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and burger sauce, with fries
Chuck patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft buns, crinkle-cut fries, delivered on a tray.
Oklahoma chicken fried steak with gravy
dinner in the small Oklahoma town

Tenderised beef steak dredged twice in seasoned flour, fried crunchy and smothered in peppery white country gravy, with mashed potato and green beans. Pound 4 x 150g thin beef minute steaks. Season 200g plain flour with salt, pepper and 1 tsp garlic powder. Dip the steaks in flour, then in 2 eggs beaten with 200ml buttermilk, then back in the flour. Shallow fry in 1cm oil at 180C for 3 minutes a side and drain. Pour off all but 3 tbsp fat, stir in 3 tbsp of the flour, whisk in 500ml milk and simmer until thick with lots of black pepper. Serve with mash and buttered beans.
W: Chocolate ganache in a cookie crust, topped with toasted meringue
Biscuit crumb base, dark chocolate ganache filling, topped with a tall marshmallow meringue torched until blistered.
K: Vanilla ice cream, milk, malt powder and chocolate sauce blended thick

Thick chocolate shakes of vanilla ice cream, cold milk, cocoa and malted milk powder, topped with whipped cream, chocolate sauce and a cherry. Blend 8 large scoops of vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 2 tbsp cocoa and 3 tbsp chocolate sauce until thick and smooth. Drizzle more chocolate sauce inside 4 tall chilled glasses, pour in the shakes and top with whipped cream and a cherry.

steps.text: Stack two marshmallows on each skewer.
Pipe eyes and a smile on each with the melted chocolate.
Toast half of them with a blowtorch for the full effect.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper and coat the okra.
Fry at 180C for 3 minutes, in batches, until crisp.
Fry the potatoes once at a gentle heat until soft, drain, then fry again at a higher heat until crisp.
Shape the mince into balls. Mix the mayo and relish for burger sauce.
Smash the balls into thin patties on a smoking griddle and add cheese.
Stack two patties per bun with pickles, onion and sauce.

steps.text: Mix the crushed biscuits with the melted butter and press into a pie tin.
Melt the chocolate with the cream, pour in and chill to set.
Whisk the egg whites with the sugar over hot water, then beat stiff.
Pile tall and torch until blistered.
Blend the ice cream with the milk, malt, cocoa and some chocolate sauce until thick and smooth.
Drizzle chocolate sauce inside tall chilled glasses.
Pour in the shakes and top with whipped cream and a cherry.

s.note: Marshmallows on skewers with chocolate faces, toasted if you like
s.how: Stack 2 big marshmallows on each of 12 bamboo skewers. Pipe eyes and a smile on each with 50g melted dark chocolate. Toast half of them with a blowtorch for the full effect.

s.note: Cornmeal crusted fried okra rounds with hot sauce
s.how: Slice 500g okra into 1cm rounds, toss in 150ml buttermilk, then in 150g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, salt and pepper. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp and serve with hot sauce.

m.note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and burger sauce, with fries
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft bun with pickles, onion and burger sauce of mayo and relish. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.note: Chocolate ganache in a cookie crust, topped with toasted meringue
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a pie tin. Pour in 200g dark chocolate melted with 200ml cream and set. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, beat stiff, pile tall and torch until blistered.

d.note: Vanilla ice cream, milk, malt powder and chocolate sauce blended thick
d.how: Blend 8 large scoops of vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 2 tbsp cocoa and 3 tbsp chocolate sauce until thick and smooth. Drizzle more chocolate sauce inside 4 tall chilled glasses, pour in the shakes and top with whipped cream and a cherry.
